package.name: jedy_description
package.description:
URDF, meshes and the servo map for the Jedy robot, as a ROS 2 (ament) package.
Ported from the catkin package in jsk-enshu/robot-programming. That one could not be found by anything under ROS 2 -- no ament index entry -- so every `package://jedy_description/meshes/...` in its URDF failed to resolve and RViz drew a complete, correctly articulated, entirely invisible robot. Being a real ament package IS the fix; nothing here rewrites a path.
This package knows nothing about actuators, buses or ros2_control. What drives the robot lives in jedy_bringup, which depends on actuo.
